values.website: A dense industrial I/O gateway on MT7621 featuring 24 isolated digital inputs, 8 relay outputs, 4x RS485, RS232, analog I/O, dual external temperature probes, and Modbus/MQTT/SNMP support. Designed for energy monitoring, process automation, and smart infrastructure.
values.catalogue: A dense industrial I/O gateway on MT7621 featuring 24 isolated digital inputs, 8 relay outputs, 4x RS485, RS232, analog I/O, dual external temperature probes, and Modbus/MQTT/SNMP support. Designed for energy monitoring, process automation, and smart infrastructure.

Single 4G MODEM
4× GIGABIT ETHERNET
Serial I/O RS485 · RS232
Wi-Fi 5 DUAL BAND
20–60 V DC INPUT

values.website:
Energy Monitoring & Power Management
Process Automation & Industrial Control
Smart Infrastructure & Remote Asset Intelligence
values.catalogue:
Energy Monitoring & Power Management — Ideal for monitoring electrical panels, DG sets, solar systems, utility meters, and RTUs using RS485/RS232 and 4-20mA transducer interfaces for real-time energy analytics and cloud data transmission.
Process Automation & Industrial Control — Can be deployed in manufacturing plants to integrate PLCs, sensors, relays, and field devices through RS485, DI/DO, and analog I/O for automated process control and predictive maintenance.
Smart Infrastructure & Remote Asset Intelligence — Suitable for smart buildings, water treatment plants, telecom shelters, agricultural systems, and remote field assets requiring field-level monitoring, MQTT/Modbus communication, and centralized remote management over cellular connectivity.
